## DAS-based upper bound (uncalibrated)
- **b = 0.9849, Sigma = −2.698, P(M≥5.5)/yr = 0.07842**

## Bottom line
Even in the most conservative calibrated scenario (b = 0.65), P(Mw ≥ 5.5) is ~1.5 % per year (6.5×10⁻⁴ over the observed volume) — a Pohang-like Mw ≥ 5.5 earthquake at Brady Hot Springs in March 2016 is unlikely, and the DAS-only 7.8 %/yr figure is an over-counting upper bound, not a calibrated probability. Note also the net fluid balance was negative (more extracted than injected), which argues against injection-driven pressurisation in this window.
